thread:
alex: Heads up — PM wants the GovCloud private-offer to land same day as the SI co-sell announcement. Need committed tiers, renewal terms, and partner incentive details. Can we sketch?
megan: We can, but legal needs ~10 business days to review private-offer T&Cs. Please lock pricing assumptions before we draft.
diego: Ops: we can run GovCloud on dedicated pools, but need expected peak RPS and concurrent sessions per tier to size capacity.
samir: Product still targeting 2024-12-12 for partner launch. Are we aligned to that date? We also need docs/one-pager and enablement.
kate: Proposal: 3-stage ramp (30d/60d/90d) with commit bands: 120k/420k/1,000k annualized. Offer a $50k SI integration rebate (off-invoice) for first year. Renewal auto-12m with 45-day opt-out.
alex: I like the off-invoice rebate approach to avoid marketplace negative-line restrictions. Finance sign-off required though.
megan: Confirmed — some marketplaces block negative line items. Off-invoice rebate works but needs explicit contract flow. Legal will draft clause for partner rebate and verification.
diego: Ops asks for a +25% buffer for launch week and an internal traffic route flag to steer GovCloud customers to the dedicated pools.
devex-bot: created RD-EX-7127 to add govcloud-routing feature flag, assigned to @julio.
julio: Picking this up. ETA 4 working days for a gating PR and can add rollout toggles for early invitees.
samir: Sales needs SKU mapping and simple pricing matrix for quoting. Also a sample TCO vs self-host with latency SLO assumptions.
kate: I'll prep the one-pager. Need an approved latency SLO for GovCloud (suggest 80ms p50, 400ms p95) and cost math for 3 usage profiles.
harriet: Finance: need revenue waterfall and margin impact by SKU to approve rebate. Also ask: is rebate refundable if customer churns early?
megan: Legal input: add audit + attestation clause — partner must provide integration completion attestation; Redwood reserves right to audit usage within 90 days of rebate claim.
alex: Good. For SKU mapping draft:
```
GOVC-DC-120 -> reserved-120k-yr
GOVC-DC-420 -> reserved-420k-yr
GOVC-DC-1000 -> reserved-1m-yr
SI-REBATE-50K -> contract-off-invoice-rebate
```
megan: Looks fine. Legal will include a rebate clawback if attestations are false.
diego: Ops: add telemetry tag for marketplace-private-offer so we can measure adoption and routing correctness.
julio: I'll add that to RD-EX-7127 as a data tag requirement.
kate: Announcement flow suggestion: private-offer goes live in invite-only marketplace first (feature-flagged), press + partner webcast same week. Marketplace public listing after 30 days.
samir: I'll coordinate sample customer case and TCO numbers by Tuesday.
harriet: Finance needs final pricing floor by Monday EOD to model the impact.
alex: Assignments: @megan draft T&Cs + rebate clause, @megan loop legal & @harriet finance; @diego capacity & telemetry, @julio flag + PR, @kate one-pager + enablement, @samir TCO + sample case. I'll own timeline and launch checklist.
julio: PR branch created today; will request reviews once RD-EX-7127 is ready.
megan: Legal note: need SI MSA signed by 2024-11-20 to keep the 12/12 launch. Also will propose a 60-day post-launch verification period for rebate eligibility.
harriet: A 60-day verification window is ok. We'll model rebate as deferred revenue contra until attestation complete.
diego: Ops will provision +25% headroom for first 14 days and revert to autoscaling thereafter.
kate: I'll share the one-pager draft in #partnerships for quick feedback tomorrow AM.
samir: Draft TCO posted — tagging @kate. Will update based on finance feedback.
alex: Next sync Wed 9am PT. If legal + finance sign-off by next week, we hit launch date. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
